name: Triad Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Building Furniture with Enduring Quality and Style Since 1977
about:
Triad Manufacturing Inc was founded in 1977 in Salina, Kansas. The company has operated under the same name since its inception, building furniture with a focus on enduring quality and style. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures a broad range of furniture products, including conference tables in various shapes and edges, executive and guest seating, healthcare and specialty seating, institutional dining furniture, soft seating, office accessories, and occasional tables. It also produces custom boardroom furniture, state house chairs, and custom hospitality pieces, and provides installation services for its products. Facility size, employee count, and annual production volumes are not published.

Triad serves corporate offices, healthcare facilities, educational and institutional dining operations, hospitality venues, and government agencies. Concrete examples from its catalog include state house chairs for legislative chambers, healthcare installations for hospitals, institutional dining furniture for cafeterias, and custom hospitality furniture for hotels and resorts.

The company’s stated differentiation rests on its long-standing commitment to quality and style, as reflected in its tagline “Building Furniture with Enduring Quality and Style Since 1977.” It emphasizes custom manufacturing capabilities and the ability to consolidate orders to a single source.
